const provider = {
  specificationVersion: 'v4',
  provider: 'gateway',
  modelId: id,
  supportedUrls: {},
  async doGenerate() { throw new Error('Only streaming calls allowed'); },
  async doStream(params) {
    const transcript = JSON.stringify(params.prompt);
    const names = (params.tools ?? []).map((tool) => tool.name).sort().join(',');
    const run = transcript.includes('Mode: approved newcomer attempt');
    const diagnose = transcript.includes('Mode: diagnose');
    if (names !== (run ? 'request_environment,run_step' : diagnose ? 'eve__reply,read_source' : 'eve__reply')) {
      throw new Error('Unexpected provider-side phase tool set: ' + names);
    }
    if (!params.maxOutputTokens || params.maxOutputTokens > 4096) throw new Error('No provider output cap');
    let action;
    let text;
    if (run && !transcript.includes('"type":"tool-result"')) {
      action = ['request_environment', '{}'];
    } else if (run && !transcript.includes('"toolName":"run_step"')) {
      action = ['run_step', '{"id":"step-1"}'];
    } else if (diagnose && !transcript.includes('"type":"tool-result"')) {
      action = ['read_source', '{"path":"test.js"}'];
    } else if (diagnose) {
      text = JSON.stringify({ cause: 'Synthetic', confidence: 'medium', edits: [] });
    } else if (run) {
      text = 'Complete';
    } else {
      text = JSON.stringify({
        status: 'missing', reason: 'No outcome', citation: { path: 'README.md', startLine: 1, endLine: 1 },
        requirements: [], steps: [], access: { egress: [], credentials: false, inbound: false },
      });
    }
    if (!run && text) action = ['eve__reply', text];
    return {
      stream: new ReadableStream({
        start(out) {
          out.enqueue({ type: 'stream-start', warnings: [] });
          if (action) {
            out.enqueue({
              type: 'tool-call', toolCallId: 'audit-' + action[0], toolName: action[0], input: action[1],
            });
          } else {
            out.enqueue({ type: 'text-start', id: '1' });
            out.enqueue({ type: 'text-delta', id: '1', delta: text });
            out.enqueue({ type: 'text-end', id: '1' });
          }
          out.enqueue({
            type: 'finish', finishReason: { unified: action ? 'tool-calls' : 'stop', raw: undefined },
            usage: {
              inputTokens: { total: 100, noCache: 100, cacheRead: 0, cacheWrite: 0 },
              outputTokens: { total: 10, text: 10, reasoning: 0 },
            },
          });
          out.close();
        },
      }),
    };
  },
};
